plan.title: Assign MRP Template to RFQ Stage

steps.note: Open the eRFX creation screen used for an RFQ commercial stage.
Enable the required template-editing configuration before entering the creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title for the draft creation flow.
Configure the event with an RFQ commercial stage.
Navigate to the RFQ commercial stage settings.
Select the required MRP Template from the stage's Templates dropdown.
Verify the MRP template remains applied to the RFQ stage.
Confirm that applying the template did not produce an application error.
